The sentinel is replaced by the smoke-chosen value in a dated amendment commit (a block named amendment_N_smoke_set below plus the manifest edit), once, before any experimental seed.

duration.duration_ticks (the experimental manifests carry the top rung 18000 until a --duration-rung step-down is locked in execution-lock.json)

smoke_may_set_only.mechanical_enforcement: in --smoke mode the runner restricts every smoke manifest's observable_ids in memory to the allow-list below and writes nothing else: no live.trait_mass_* value, no H1/H2 effect, no paired-report.json, no per-seed-deltas.csv, no manifest copy (manifests name every observable; their sha256 is recorded in provenance.json instead). The runner refuses (returns an error) to print or write any smoke text containing 'trait_mass'. Files written: runs.csv (header line states the allow-list), smoke-series.csv, smoke-report.json, provenance.json, summary.md, checksums.sha256.
smoke_may_set_only.must_not_consult: any live.trait_mass_* observable (mean, var, p10, p90), in any smoke run, for any choice; the amendment that records smoke results reports only live.agent_count and live.standing_crop (and the measured microseconds per tick)
smoke_may_set_only.T_smoke: 18000 ticks (the top rung, the duration the smoke manifests carry and plan section 6 prescribes) for every smoke run of steps B and C; step A reads only the samples with tick <= 1200 of its abundant run. Samples exist at the registered sample_period (600), so step A sees the samples at ticks 600 and 1200. The smoke never changes sample_period.
smoke_may_set_only.rounding: a candidate food_cap is round-half-up to the nearest integer, at least 1: max(1, floor(x + 0.5))

algorithm.step_A_F_hi: N0 = 30, food_cap F = 50 (FoodSpawnSettings::default().max_food_count). Run the abundant smoke. Compute max live.agent_count over smoke samples with tick <= 1200. If it is > 80 set F := F - 10 and repeat (floor 20: F is never below 20; if F = 20 still gives > 80, stop and file a finding, no experiment). F_hi = the first F that passes (max <= 80).
algorithm.step_B_N0: For N0 in 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80 (in that order): run the abundant smoke at F_hi and the scarce smoke at round(F_hi / 2); accept the first N0 for which min live.agent_count over ALL samples is >= 5 in BOTH runs. If none passes, stop and file a finding (no experiment).
algorithm.step_C_F_lo: With the accepted N0, for c in 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/8 (in that order): run the scarce smoke at round(c * F_hi) (the c = 1/2 run is the scarce run of step B, reused, not re-run); let r = (mean live.standing_crop over samples with tick > T_smoke / 2 in that scarce run) / (the same mean in the abundant run at F_hi and the accepted N0). Accept the FIRST c with 0.4 <= r <= 0.6 AND min live.agent_count >= 5 over all samples of the scarce run. F_lo = round(c * F_hi). If none passes, stop and file a finding (the survival constraint is never relaxed).
algorithm.duration_rung: Measure microseconds per tick for every smoke run (release build; provenance.timing.us_per_tick of each smoke invocation, the mean over the runs of that invocation). estimated_total_minutes = 36 runs x T x (max us/tick over all smoke runs at the chosen N0 and F values, i.e. those of steps B and C at the accepted N0) / 60e6, with no parallelism credit. Choose the HIGHEST rung T of 18000 / 12000 / 6000 with estimated_total_minutes <= 90. N is never lowered. If even 6000 exceeds 90 minutes: stop and file a finding.
algorithm.no_other_choices: No quantity other than N0, F_hi, F_lo and the duration rung is chosen by the smoke. The H1 direction is NOT chosen by the smoke: it is two_sided, fixed in this registration (see pre_run_tightening_2026-11-17).

smoke_may_set_only.must_not_be_chosen_by: any body-mass outcome (every choice uses live.agent_count, live.standing_crop and the measured time only)
smoke_manifests_may_differ_from_experime: live.mutation_rate (only the smoke drift manifest, which holds 0, as the drift manifest does)
smoke_may_set_only.smoke_starting_candidates_in_smoke_manif: esel1-smoke-abundant.json carries live.founders = 30, live.food_cap = 50; esel1-smoke-scarce.json carries live.food_cap = 25 (round(F_hi / 2) at F_hi = 50); esel1-smoke-drift-scarce-mutation-off.json carries live.founders = 30, live.food_cap = 25, live.mutation_rate = 0. These are the algorithm's first candidates, not results. Later candidates are tried by editing ONLY live.founders and live.food_cap in the smoke manifests, which are excluded from analysis. The runner requires the smoke drift manifest to differ from the smoke scarce manifest in exactly live.mutation_rate, so the final smoke invocation (the one that exercises the drift path) carries the same founders and food_cap in both.

h1_direction: two_sided, fixed in this registration before any run (pre_run_tightening_2026-11-17). It is not a smoke output and nothing in the smoke may set or change it.

pre_run_tightening_2026-11-17.attribution: Amendment of the registration made by the lead session after an independent verifier's review, 2026-11-17, BEFORE any run.
pre_run_tightening_2026-11-17.no_smoke_or_experimental_run_had_been_ma: no smoke or experimental run had been made when this block was written; no run of any manifest in this directory exists, in any build.
changes: G3: H1 direction fixed as two_sided now; hypotheses[H1].direction = two_sided; the smoke no longer may set a direction; direction_fixed_after_smoke and the placeholder marker on the direction are removed

G4: every smoke rule is now the mechanical algorithm in smoke_may_set_only.algorithm (step A F_hi, step B N0, step C F_lo, duration rung); the smoke consults only live.agent_count and live.standing_crop, never a live.trait_mass_* value
G5: duration rung = highest of 18000 / 12000 / 6000 whose 36 runs x T x max us/tick estimate is <= 90 minutes, no parallelism credit

G6: smoke drift manifest esel1-smoke-drift-scarce-mutation-off.json added (seed 999971 only, scarce food at F_hi / 2, live.mutation_rate = 0) and listed as manifests.smoke_drift, so the runner's smoke exercises the drift path once; its result is never used for any choice

G2: the runner refuses --ensemble when execution-lock.json lacks duration_ticks, N0, F_hi or F_lo, or when they disagree with the manifests in --manifest-dir; execution-lock.json is listed in checksums.sha256 and its sha256 is recorded in provenance.json

G1/G7: scripts/verify_esel1_artifacts.mjs fails on an existing but empty or incomplete artifact directory, recomputes the H1 statistics from per-seed-deltas.csv and the materiality verdict, and checks the lock hash against provenance.json

G4 (mechanical): the smoke's ban on consulting live.trait_mass_* is enforced by the runner, not by discipline. In --smoke mode no live.trait_mass_* value (or H1/H2 effect computed from one) is written to any file or stdout: only the allow-listed observables (agent_count, standing_crop, closed_eu_total, births, deaths), the timing (us/tick per run), checksums and provenance. A test asserts that a --smoke invocation on synthetic manifests that request every observable produces no file containing 'trait_mass'; verify_esel1_artifacts.mjs re-checks this on a real smoke directory
G4 (Step A floor, decided by the coordinator): at F = 20 with a maximum agent_count still above 80 the smoke stops and files a finding
G8: a shape test asserts that smoke manifests differ from the experimental ones only in live.founders, live.food_cap, seeds (and live.mutation_rate for the smoke drift manifest)

amendment_1_2026-11-17_smoke_run_1_stopp.attribution: Amendment 1, made by the lead session under the owner's delegation on 2026-11-17, after smoke run 1 stopped and BEFORE any experimental seed ran. No experimental manifest has been run in any build.

smoke_run_1.driver: scripts/esel1_smoke_driver.mjs (applies smoke_may_set_only.algorithm; reads only live.agent_count, live.standing_crop, us/tick and the final checksum)
smoke_run_1.step_A: N0 = 30, F = 50: max live.agent_count at tick <= 1200 = 74 (<= 80), so F_hi candidate = 50
smoke_run_1.step_B: N0 = 30: min live.agent_count over all samples = 13 in the abundant run (F 50) and 13 in the scarce run (F 25), so N0 candidate = 30
smoke_run_1.step_C: r = 1 exactly for c = 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 and 1/8 (food caps 25, 17, 13, 6): the scarce runs' mean live.standing_crop over tick > 9000 equalled the abundant run's (123973.79). No c passed, so the smoke STOPPED as the algorithm requires.
smoke_run_1.values_from_run_1_are_void: None of N0 = 30 or F_hi = 50 from run 1 is carried forward: run 2 re-runs the algorithm from step A.

amendment_1_2026-11-17_smoke_run_1_stopp.cause: F-043 (FINDINGS.md): apply_environmental_effects_system rewrote FoodSpawnSettings::max_food_count as 50 x event multiplier on every tick, so a declared live.food_cap lived only until the first tick. In run 1 the abundant and scarce arms of every trial ended on the same final checksum, bit for bit: the declared factor did nothing.
amendment_1_2026-11-17_smoke_run_1_stopp.change_to_the_model: fix(live): the adapter inserts LiveFoodCap(live.food_cap) on genesis and restore, and the system scales that base instead of the literal 50. A world without LiveFoodCap (every app run, every manifest that omits live.food_cap) keeps the literal 50, so the default path is unchanged (live_food_cap_tests).
amendment_1_2026-11-17_smoke_run_1_stopp.unchanged: The question, declared factor (live.food_cap), primary metric, tail window, thresholds, H1 (two_sided), seeds and their order, N, the smoke algorithm (steps A, B, C), the duration ladder and the 90-minute budget are all unchanged.
amendment_1_2026-11-17_smoke_run_1_stopp.added_precondition: Manipulation check, applied by the driver to every smoke trial: when the abundant and scarce arms differ in food cap but end on the same final checksum, the smoke stops (the factor is inert). It can stop the smoke; it can never choose a value.
amendment_1_2026-11-17_smoke_run_1_stopp.re_arm: Smoke run 2 runs the unchanged algorithm from step A on the commit that merges this amendment, on a clean checkout, with the driver above. Its N0, F_hi, F_lo and rung are then written in amendment 2 with execution-lock.json, before any experimental seed.
amendment_1_2026-11-17_smoke_run_1_stopp.if_run_2_stops_again: If run 2 stops at step C with the manipulation check passing (the cap now changes the world but live.standing_crop does not fall to 0.4-0.6 of abundant), live.food_cap is a real but weak scarcity factor for this world. That is filed as a finding and the experiment does not run under this registration; a different scarcity factor needs a new registration, which is the owner's decision.
minor_gaps_noted_by_the_independent_veri: Step A's 80-agent gate is checked at N0 = 30 only; step B may raise N0 at F_hi without re-checking it. The algorithm is followed literally.
Step A reads two samples (ticks 600 and 1200), as registered.
The runner's refusal of sentinel manifests is indirect (the live config parser rejects negatives); scripts/verify_esel1_artifacts.mjs also rejects a lock against sentinel manifests.
execution-lock.json's manifest_sha256 is optional in the runner; amendment 2 will record it anyway.
The smoke writes each run's final checksum, which depends on the whole state; it carries no body-mass value.

amendment_2_2026-11-17_smoke_run_2_stopp.attribution: Amendment 2, made by the lead session under the owner's delegation on 2026-11-17, after smoke run 2. No experimental manifest has been run in any build; the experimental manifests still hold their sentinels and cannot be run.

smoke_run_2.manipulation_check: passed in every trial: the abundant arm (cap 50) ended on checksum 1859816024 and the scarce arms (caps 25, 17, 13, 6) on 212870692, 1699954573, 4171667680 and 1554494529, so live.food_cap now changes the world
smoke_run_2.step_A: N0 = 30, F = 50: max live.agent_count at tick <= 1200 = 74 (<= 80), F_hi candidate = 50
smoke_run_2.step_B: N0 = 30: min live.agent_count over all samples = 13 (abundant, F 50) and 30 (scarce, F 25), N0 candidate = 30

amendment_2_2026-11-17_smoke_run_2_stopp.outcome: Per amendment 1 (if_run_2_stops_again): live.food_cap is a real but weak scarcity factor for this world. Cutting the food-item cap from 50 to 6 moves the grazing field's standing crop by at most 6 percent, far from the registered 40 to 60 percent of abundant. E-SEL1 therefore does NOT run under this registration. Its experimental manifests keep their sentinels (PLACEHOLDERS_OPEN stays true), so they remain unrunnable.
observations_not_used_for_any_choice: The drift arm (scarce food, live.mutation_rate = 0) went extinct in every trial of run 2 (ticks 3600, 2400, 4800, 6600), and in run 1 (tick 7200), while the same configuration at the default rate 0.05 never went extinct. Single seed (999971); an exploratory diagnosis on other seeds was started separately and is not part of this registration.
The abundant arm's minimum live.agent_count (13) was lower than every scarce arm's (24 to 33). Single seed.
amendment_2_2026-11-17_smoke_run_2_stopp.what_a_new_registration_needs: A scarcity factor that actually depresses the food supply the population lives on (the grazing field, whose standing crop the smoke measures) needs a new manifest key and a new registration, which is the owner's decision. Nothing here licenses changing this registration's factor.

hypotheses.contrast: drift (scarce, mutation off) vs treatment (scarce): delta = scarce_mut0 - scarce
hypotheses.rationale: descriptive only; does not separate selection from drift (plan section 5.3)
a drift in closed EU, or live.births == 0 while the population grew, is filed as a defect finding, not as biology

seeds.rule: seed_k = 760001 + 1000*k for k in 0..11, fixed before any run; disjoint from E2 700001.., E3 draft 730001.., E2R 750001..
seeds.smoke_seed_exclusion_is_mechanical: 999971 is absent from every experimental manifest's seed list, and run_manifest_seed returns RunStatus::Failed{SeedNotInManifest} for a seed the manifest does not declare.

duration.ladder_rule: Chosen ONCE from the smoke, before any experimental seed runs, written to execution-lock.json. Never changed after an experimental seed has run.

extinction_rule.fewer_than_10_complete_pairs: insufficient_evidence; no replacement seeds, N is never changed

cost.runs: 36 (control, treatment and drift arms x 12 seeds)
cost.on_budget_exceeded: step down the duration ladder using the smoke only, before any experimental seed runs; never lower N

decision_rule.shift_in_model_only_if: H1 reaches materiality AND >= 10 complete pairs AND no harness-integrity finding is open AND cargo test --features desktop is green
decision_rule.null_if: H1 is null or below materiality with >= 10 complete pairs
decision_rule.insufficient_evidence_if: fewer than 10 complete pairs, or a blocking precondition was satisfied in a way that departs from this preregistration
decision_rule.defects_are_not_insufficiency: a real defect found during the run is recorded and fixed as a defect

limitations_stated_in_advance: prey only (predator_fraction = 0): predators do not persist yet; no predation pressure
one terrain (the adapter's fixed map seed) and the headless adapter
body mutation probability is a declared constant per arm (0.05 or 0.0), not an experimental dose
drive floor 0.5 makes speed less heritable (a viability aid, ADR-0007)
will_not_be_claimed: adaptation or local adaptation (CM-S11 not run)
anything about predators, Red-Queen coevolution (S43) or brains
generality beyond one terrain seed and the headless adapter
